title: wss: extensions break RFC 8887 4.2/4.3 MUSTs
description: RFC 8887 4.2: 'Other message types MUST NOT be transmitted'; 4.3 restricts client and server frame forms. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md:99 argues capability negotiation overrides this, which a draft cannot do by assertion. draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md and draft-atwood-jmap-scene-wss-00.md do not address it (scene part was jmap-chat-spec-jlsm.19). Fix: updates: 8887 in each draft plus a section stating the update.
close_reason: Added updates: 8887 and an 'Update to RFC 8887' section to chat/vtc/scene-wss: capabilities may define message types; server MUST NOT send new server-to-client types unless the client enabled them.
